llmJudgeRequirements.description: Profile `queryFn` reads `signal` from `QueryFunctionContext` and passes it to `fetchProfile`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Profile queryFn is an arrow function with no parameters; it does not destructure signal from QueryFunctionContext nor pass it to the fetch call
Projects query uses key ['relatedRows', profileId] not ['projects', profileId]

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Projects query `enabled` option is set from boolean cast of `profileId`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: enabled is set via typeof check (typeof profileId === 'number') rather than a boolean cast (!!profileId or Boolean(profileId))
